S0.1 states that one machine with liminf T_A(n)/(n lg n)=0 refutes the eventual lower bound and that the bound gives limit zero through all lengths, as at 381-387. The paper has no derivation beyond this.

chain: The tree follows the paper's route: the bit network gives the rank-saving interchange (S1), the complex network gives the simultaneous butterfly layer (S2), these feed the synthetic transforms and ring convolution (S3), resampling and chirp cancellation (S4), and assembly, exact recovery and time accounting (S5, S6) reach O(n(lg n)^{1-kappa}). The address-interchange branch is reconstructed nearly line by line. The tree is thinner at the label verification (gate-label and residual tables, orthonormal bases over F_2), the complex endpoint computation, the complex deficit eta_c, the layer's guard-depth recurrence, and the intermediate error chain of exact recovery, where results are quoted rather than derived.

steps.note: h=100, banks X_a,Y_a indexed by triples of three-element subsets, three stages giving (X_a,Y_a)->(-Y_a,X_a) with every scratch wire restored, and m=h^3 (S1.1.3) are present. N=binom(h,3)^3 is implicit in the indexing rather than written out.
The common frame commutes with the pointwise gate, so the network implements D_out S D_in^{-1}, and the intermediate frames are free to make edge changes cheap.

Nondegenerate labels in F^{tensor 3} of dimension m, built from triple indicators that are orthogonal for neighbours. Every edge joins comparable labels, and the only decrease is on central wires from time 3 to 4, each losing h.
For nested U in V, P_V-P_U has rank dim V-dim U. The N source edges with matrix 2P_{U_a} are rank-one exceptions.
L=Ich, sum of |Delta dim|=Wm-2N+2L by telescoping at gates, and s_b=W_bm-N+2L_b are all stated.
L_b/N=100/539 and L_c/N=101/539, both below 1/2, giving deficits N-2L_b>0 and 2N-2L_c>0, hence s<Wm.
The endpoint difference is I_m on every role (P_{U_a^perp}+P_{U_a} on X_a, identity minus zero elsewhere), so every row, scratch rows included, undergoes H<-H+D.
A=E_1 Pi E_2, triangular parts in O(V), and each one of Pi costs one interchange, so a rank-a edge makes a recursive calls and a node makes s calls in all.
Children of volume V/W, F_k<=(s/W)F_{k-1}+O(1), s/W<m^tau with tau=1-2^{-50} from eta_b>20*2^{-50} and log m<20, and F_k=O(e^tau) are all present.

central.summary: All nine central steps are reconstructed with their defining quantities: the fixed exchange network, frames, nested labels with the single decreasing central edge, rank equal to dimension change with the N rank-one source exceptions, the budget s_b=W_bm-N+2L_b, the ratios 100/539 and 101/539, the endpoint identity, edges as rank-many recursive interchanges, and the recurrence with tau=1-2^{-50}. The only implicit quantity is N=binom(100,3)^3.
